suite_name: Suite 2: Password Reset Email Delivery Comprehensive Test Suite

tests.name: Valid Institute Email Lookup
tests.details: Queries students table by registered institute email

tests.name: Unregistered Email Anti-Enumeration Uniformity
tests.details: Returns success response regardless of email existence to prevent user enumeration

tests.name: Empty Email Parameter Rejection
tests.details: Rejects empty or omitted email with HTTP 400 error

tests.name: Malformed Email (Missing @) Rejection
tests.details: Requires @ symbol in email parameter

tests.name: Case-Insensitive Email Normalization
tests.details: Converts input email to lowercase before database query

tests.name: Whitespace Trimming on Email Inputs
tests.details: Strips surrounding whitespace from email input

tests.name: Identical Response Payload Contract
tests.details: Single shared exit point guarantees byte-for-byte identical responses

tests.name: No Pending Record Created for Non-Students
tests.details: Guards database write operations behind student existence check

tests.name: 60s Cooldown Pending Reset Query
tests.details: Scopes rate limiting lookup to password reset attempts for specific email

tests.name: Reset Cooldown Enforcement (HTTP 429)
tests.details: Returns HTTP 429 when reset requested within 60 seconds

tests.name: Human-Readable Cooldown Message
tests.details: Explicit message informs client to wait 60s before retrying

tests.name: Elapsed Reset Cooldown Window Allows Dispatch
tests.details: Requests with >60s elapsed proceed to dispatch

tests.name: Atomic Prior Reset Record Purge
tests.details: Invalidates existing unconsumed reset codes before issuing new token

tests.name: Purpose Partitioning (REGISTRATION vs PASSWORD_RESET)
tests.details: Separate purpose flags isolate registration OTPs from password reset OTPs

tests.name: Cryptographic 6-Digit Reset OTP
tests.details: Generates 6-digit cryptographically secure numeric code

tests.name: Cryptographic Salt Generation for Reset OTP
tests.details: Produces unique 16-byte random hex salt per reset request

tests.name: Salted SHA-256 Reset Hash Generation
tests.details: Computes 64-char SHA-256 digest over salt:otp

tests.name: 15-Minute Expiration Calculation
tests.details: 15 minutes expiration window enforced for password resets

tests.name: Expired Reset Code Rejection
tests.details: Rejects reset attempts when timestamp exceeds expiration

tests.name: Atomic Deletion of Expired Reset Record
tests.details: Purges expired token to prevent state leakage

tests.name: Malformed Reset OTP Format Rejection
tests.details: Enforces exact 6-digit numeric pattern on verification

tests.name: Reset OTP Length Boundaries (<6 or >6 Rejection)
tests.details: Rejects any token string length not equal to 6

tests.name: Valid Reset OTP Verification Match
tests.details: Correct OTP matches stored SHA-256 hash

tests.name: Wrong OTP Rejection & Remaining Attempts Display
tests.details: Returns remaining attempt count to user upon invalid OTP

tests.name: Single-Digit Reset OTP Tampering Rejection
tests.details: Off-by-one alteration fails verification check

tests.name: Transposed Digit Tampering Rejection
tests.details: Digit swap fails verification check

tests.name: Salt Mismatch Rejection on Reset OTP
tests.details: Cross-request salt reuse fails verification

tests.name: Timing-Safe Comparison in Reset Route Handler
tests.details: Calls timing-safe verification helper on reset verification

tests.name: Missing Parameters Rejection (HTTP 400)
tests.details: Enforces mandatory presence of email, code, and newPassword

tests.name: No Active Reset Record Guard
tests.details: Rejects requests when no active reset challenge is logged in database

tests.name: Password Min Length (<8 Characters Rejection)
tests.details: Enforces minimum 8-character password policy

tests.name: Valid Password Length Acceptance (>=8 Characters)
tests.details: Accepts passwords meeting length requirement

tests.name: confirm_auth_user RPC Invocation
tests.details: Executes administrative RPC to update password in auth.users

tests.name: Bcrypt Hashing in confirm_auth_user RPC
tests.details: Uses Blowfish crypt salt with factor 10 for password storage

tests.name: RPC Failure Handling & HTTP 500 Response
tests.details: Catches RPC errors and returns structured failure response

tests.details: Deletes reset token immediately after successful password update

tests.name: Replay Defense on Consumed Reset Code
tests.details: Second attempt finds no record and returns 400

tests.name: Old Password Invalidation via Hash Overwrite

tests.name: Failed Attempt Counter Increment
tests.details: Increments attempts column on each wrong reset code submission

tests.name: Remaining Attempts Calculation
tests.details: Computes exact remaining chances before permanent lockout

tests.details: Deletes pending reset challenge to prevent further brute-force attacks

tests.name: Post-Lockout Attempt Denial
